 How to Watch Cavaliers vs Nets

 Cleveland returns home looking to bounce back after a 114-106 loss to the Philadelphia 76ers in its season opener. Led by Donovan Mitchell and Evan Mobley, the Cavaliers have the talent to compete with the best teams in the Eastern Conference. Establishing their defensive presence and finding an offensive rhythm will be important as they look to secure their first victory of the young season.

Brooklyn will need a strong defensive effort, efficient shooting, and contributions throughout its lineup to keep pace with the Cavaliers on Saturday night.
